subject: general
question:
Find incorrect statement(s) about light and optics.

1. Due to reflection of light, the sun is visible a little before the actual sunrise and until a little after the actual sunset due to refraction of light through the atmosphere.

2. Mirages are creates by total internal reflection of light between layers of hot air.

3. An observer can see a rainbow only when the sun is at 90 degrees to his shoulder.

Select the correct answer :
solution:
The correct answer is__** Only 1 and 3.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **It is due to atmospheric refraction ,the sun is visible a little before the actual sunrise and until a little after the actual sunset due to refraction of light through the atmosphere.**
 
• ** Mirages are creates by total internal reflection of light between layers of hot air.**
 
• **To view a rainbow, your back must be to the sun as you look at an approximately 40 degree angle above the ground into a region of the atmosphere with suspended droplets of water or even a light mist.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**__** Reflection**__

__
 
• **When a ray of light incident on a smooth polished surface and the light ray bounces back, it is called the reflection of light.**
 
• The laws of reflection determine the** reflection of incident light rays on reflecting surfaces, like mirrors, smooth metal surfaces and clear water.**
 
• The law of reflection states that:
 
• **The incident ray, the reflected ray and the normal all lie in the same plane.**
 
• **The angle of incidence = Angle of reflection.**** __**

__Refraction__

 
• **The change in direction of a wave passing from one medium to another caused by its change in speed.**
 
• Twinkling of stars in a clear sky, Pool of water appears to be less deep than what it actually is , Rainbow formation in the sky ,Camera lenses , Glasses are some common example of refraction of light.
